reviews.text: I really like this cleansing oil! It has a lightweight texture and melts away makeup, sunscreen, and impurities really well. It emulsifies nicely with water and rinses off without leaving a greasy film. My skin feels clean, soft, and comfortable afterward, not dry or tight. I’ve been using it every day and really enjoy how gentle yet effective it is!
reviews.zh: 我好鍾意呢款卸妝油！質地輕盈，好有效咁溶走彩妝、防曬同污垢。遇水乳化得好好，沖走之後唔會留有油膜。之後皮膚感覺乾淨、柔軟、舒服，唔會乾或者緊繃。我每日都用，真係好鍾意佢又溫和又有效！

reviews.text: Need three pumps to cover face, neck and forearm where I apply sunscreen in the morning. Easy to use, a slight fragrance which i can accept. Feels quite moisturized but not for a very long time. I've got combi skin. Start to feel the tightness on the cheeks a few minutes after wash face. Cleaning effect is good and no need to second wash (I only wear sunscreen). Easily emulsified. Gift pack was great with cleansing milk, serum sample. Bought during September sale.
reviews.zh: 早上塗防曬嗰陣，要泵三下先夠塗面、頸同前臂。好易用，有少少香味，我接受得。感覺都幾滋潤，但唔係好耐。我係混合皮。洗完面幾分鐘之後，開始覺得面頰緊。清潔效果好好，唔需要二次清潔（我只係用防曬）。容易乳化。送嘅禮盒好好，有潔面奶同精華樣本。我係九月大減價期間買嘅。

reviews.text: This oil cleanser has a thicker consistency compared to other oil cleansers. I have dehydrated-oily skin type and it cleanses my sunscreen and bb cushion makeup effectively. Needs to thoroughly rinse with water. Leaves my skin feeling moisturized. I think this is more suitable for dry skin types.
reviews.zh: 呢款卸妝油比其他卸妝油質地更稠。我嘅膚質係缺水性油性皮膚，佢可以有效卸走防曬同 BB 氣墊粉底。要用水充分沖洗。洗完之後皮膚感覺滋潤。我覺得呢款更加啱乾性皮膚。

reviews.text:
I’ve only used it once since purchasing it, and so far, it seems to leave my face feeling moisturised, which I think is a good thing. I haven’t tried using it with makeup on yet.

However, they claim that you can see blackhead dirt coming out while rubbing the product in, and I didn’t really experience that. So, I’m not entirely sure about the exfoliation part yet
reviews.zh:
自從買咗之後，我只用過一次，目前睇落用完之後面部感覺滋潤，我覺得係好事。我仲未試過化妝後用。

不過，佢哋聲稱搓揉產品嗰陣會見到黑頭污垢浮出嚟，但我冇真正遇到呢個情況。所以，我對佢去角質嘅功效仲未完全肯定。

reviews.text:
Omg… this is absolutely one of my favourites and i’m not surprised how well received this product got

Bought this since people have been raving its effectiveness and active ingredients.

Seriously helps my sensitive skin and had a bit of a rough time with cleansing oils but this product absolutely changed my mind.

This cleanser as I don’t wear much makeup is so good as a cleanser but isn’t a cleanser that can strip alot easily, which is good for us sensitive skin types.

Also highly recommend them if you like massaging your face alot, i spend a good 5 minutes just massaging my T-zone, forehead, cheeks and jaw to get all the pores and potential blackheads melted/removed.

Get them when stock is available though as i’m lucky to get them.
reviews.zh:
天啊……呢款絕對係我最愛嘅產品之一，我一啲都唔奇怪呢款產品會咁受歡迎。

因為大家都讚佢效果同有效成分，所以我先買。

真係幫到我嘅敏感皮膚，我之前用卸妝油都有啲唔順，但係呢款產品真係令我改變咗睇法。

我唔太常化妝，所以用佢做潔面都好好，而且佢唔會輕易剝走好多油分，對我哋敏感肌嚟講好好。

如果你好鍾意按摩面部，我都好推薦。我會花足五分鐘，單係按摩 T 字位、前額、面頰同下巴，將所有毛孔同潛在嘅黑頭溶化／清除。

有貨嗰陣記得買，我都係好彩先買到。

reviews.text: Es mi desmaquillante favorito, en mi piel latina se siente espectacularmente bien y remueve perfectamente el rímel sin irritarme los ojos, si lo masajeas por más de un minuto puedes sentir como pequeños comedones sale sobre todo en el área de mejillas y nariz, no me deja la piel seca ni irritada y remueve muy bien la suciedad del día, sin duda lo volveré a comprar, he visto comentaríos donde dicen que no te quita todos los “puntos negros” pero ese es un limpiador no un exfoliante y si cumple muy bien su función
reviews.zh: 佢係我最愛嘅卸妝產品。用喺我嘅拉丁裔皮膚上感覺非常好，而且可以完美卸走睫毛膏，唔會刺激眼睛。如果按摩多過一分鐘，可以感覺到細粒粉刺浮出嚟，主要係面頰同鼻位。佢唔會令皮膚乾燥或者刺激，又可以好好咁清走一日嘅污垢。我一定會再買，我見過有評論話佢唔可以清走所有「黑頭」，但嗰個係潔面產品，唔係去角質產品，而佢都好好咁做到自己嘅功用。

reviews.text: Okay, this cleansing oil is honestly amazing. I use it every night to take off sunscreen and it literally melts everything off without making my face feel dry or oily after. It’s super gentle (I have acne-prone skin) and it doesn’t break me out at all. It rinses off clean and makes my skin feel soft, not tight. Also, it doesn’t sting my eyes which is a big win.
reviews.zh: 好啦，呢款卸妝油真係好正。我每晚都用佢卸防曬，而且真係可以將所有嘢溶走，洗完唔會覺得面乾或者油。佢好溫和（我係易生暗瘡嘅皮膚），而且完全唔會令我爆痘。沖洗得好乾淨，令皮膚感覺柔軟，唔會緊繃。另外，佢唔會刺激眼睛，呢點係一大優點。

reviews.text: With my mature skin I have only been using this two or three times a week and have had no issues with it at all, no breakouts or irritation. Its doesnt dry my skin out or make it feel oily afterwards. Its a very nice oil cleanser. I do warm it up in my hands about a minute before putting it on my face. My skin feels clean and refreshed after using this. Will continue to use this one, a great addition to my skincare routine.
reviews.zh: 我嘅皮膚已經成熟，我只係每星期用兩至三次，完全冇出現任何問題，冇爆痘，亦冇刺激。佢唔會令皮膚乾燥，用完之後亦唔會覺得油。係一款好好嘅卸妝油。我會喺面上塗之前，先用手掌搓暖大約一分鐘。用完之後皮膚感覺乾淨清爽。我會繼續用呢款，係我護膚步驟嘅好補充。

note: 以下評價由 Olive Young 顧客撰寫，OUJI 原文引用、只加中文翻譯，冇改動內容，亦冇刪走負評。只顯示我哋有貨嘅色號，同價錢有關嘅評價唔會收錄（兩邊售價唔同）。
